description: Wait until something happens (after the call). Events: chat_match, hud_match, screen_open, screen_closed, log_match, player_join {pattern}, resource_pack (a client's server pack loaded or failed; pattern on status), server_switch (proxy; pattern on "Bob lobby -> games"). Server, every tick: block, player_near, inventory, event, message, expr {js}. Returns what held and its value. Details: craftwire://docs/tools.
name: wait_for
